newsitem.title: USA: World Color Press to buy Rand McNally unit. [CORRECTED 17:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: World Color Press to buy Rand McNally unit. [CORRECTED 17:35 GMT]

text.p: World Color Press Inc said it agreed to acquire Rand McNally's Rand McNally Book Services Group unit for an undisclosed amount.
The unit, which produces hardcover books, has annual revenue of about $150 million, World Color said.
The acquisition will be "accretive" to World Color's earnings in the 1997 second quarter, a World Color spokeswoman said, although she declined to specify by how much.
(Corrects spokeswoman's reference, making clear impact on earnings of acquisition will not be immediate).
World Color, based in Greenwich, Connecticut, said it expects to close the transaction this month.
